Msg.Desc:
"Unable to load %s because the COMPBROWSER section is missing in the following files in the Cadence installation:
share/cdssetup/lman/browser.cpm share/cdssetup/projmgr/cds.cpm
This can occur if these files have been manually modified. Ensure that the COMPBROWSER section is available in these files."
" Unable to save the Part Information Manager settings in the project cpm file. There might be locked directive(s)."
"Ignoring cell %s of library %s. A cell with the same name exists in %s. Ensure only one instance of a cell exists across all libraries."
"Duplicate cells found while loading the project, only the first instance of the cell is displayed and all others are ignored. Ensure only one instance of a cell exists across all libraries."

"The Suppress_Duplicate_Cell_Details directive is set to TRUE in the project cpm file so no details of duplicate cells will be displayed. To see all the details of the duplicate cells, set Suppress_Duplicate_Cell_Details directive to FALSE. This will come into effect at the next time the project cpm file is read by the design capture application."

"Block %s found in %s library of server and Worklib. Though the block would be added from the Worklib, any Block PTF properties would be annotated using the data from the server. It is recommended that you rename the block in your worklib to continue."
